name: Sierra Horizon
desc: Sierra platform for agents that chase goals over days or weeks.
desc_zh: 让智能体用几天到几周时间追一个目标的 Sierra 平台
solves: Conversational agents finish one call and stop. Horizon agents keep working a goal across days or weeks, deciding each next step and learning from every outcome.
solves_zh: 对话式智能体结束一通电话就停了。Horizon 智能体为一个目标连续工作数天到数周，自己决定下一步，并从每次结果里学习。
best_for: The outcome needs dozens of texts and calls spread over weeks, not one conversation.
best_for_zh: 这个结果要靠几周内几十条短信和电话才能换来，而不是一通对话。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://sierra.ai/blog (the vendor's own news directory), then the announcem）。 Sierra calls Horizon its most significant expansion since the 2024 launch and describes an outcomes-based pricing model ('you pay for results, not tokens'). Distinct from the ledger's Sierra AI (2024-02-01), which is the conversational platform; Sierra positions Agent OS as the conversational base and Horizon as the long-horizon layer. No dedicated product page was found, so the homepage is Sierra's product page. 评审修正（2026-11-25）：官方名字「Horizon」是通用词，带上厂商名以便辨认。 首次公开日期来源：https://sierra.ai/blog/horizon
